# Environment variables

Variable names and their comments from each example file. Values are never shown.

## `infra/api.env.example`

Read by compose services: `api`.

| Variable | Comment |
| --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` | Set by docker-compose.yml for the containers it starts (its `environment:` wins over this file). Fill them in only to run the API outside compose. |
| `REDIS_URL` |  |
| `CELERY_BROKER_URL` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_ID` | The GitHub App. The private key is the App's PEM, base64-encoded on one line. |
| `GITHUB_APP_SLUG` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_WEBHOOK_SECRET` |  |
| `API_BASE_URL` | Where GitHub sends the user back to, and the Host values the UI and API answer to (comma-separated; add a tunnel hostname here). |
| `UI_ALLOWED_HOSTS` |  |
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Billing and sign-in (optional; unset, those routes answer 503). Use a Stripe sandbox and a restricted key (rk_) while developing; keep live keys out of this file. |
| `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` |  |
| `STRIPE_PRICE_ID` |  |
| `SESSION_SECRET` |  |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID` |  |
| `GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET` |  |

## `infra/worker.env.example`

Read by compose services: `worker`.

| Variable | Comment |
| --- | --- |
| `GITHUB_APP_ID` | The GitHub App the pipeline clones and pushes as. The private key is the App's PEM, base64-encoded on one line. |
| `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64` |  |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | Model providers (gateway/models.toml routes each stage to a model). Fill in the key for each provider your models.toml actually uses and leave the others empty. They are handed to LiteLLM per call and are never exported into the process environment, so git, docker and the sandbox cannot inherit them. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` |  |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` |  |
| `MINIMAX_API_KEY` |  |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | A Vertex AI API key (not an AI Studio key), for the vertex-gemini-* models. |

## `infra/site.env.example`

Read by compose services: `site`.

| Variable | Comment |
| --- | --- |
| `SITE_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | The Host values the site answers to (comma-separated). Anything else gets a 400. |
| `SITE_DATABASE_URL` | A Postgres role that may INSERT into waitlist_signups and nothing else. Unset: the form answers 503. postgresql+asyncpg://repolace_site:<password>@postgres:5432/repolace |
| `TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY` | Cloudflare Turnstile (optional; set both to turn the human check on). |
| `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY` |  |
| `SITE_TRUST_CF_IP` | Trust CF-Connecting-IP when the TCP peer is loopback or a private address (the tunnel connector on the same host, directly or over a Docker bridge). The port is published on 127.0.0.1 only. |

## `.env.example`

Read by no compose service; read by host processes (CLI, benchmark runner, tests).

| Variable | Comment |
| --- | --- |
| `DATABASE_URL` |  |
| `REDIS_PASSWORD` |  |
| `REDIS_URL` |  |
| `CELERY_BROKER_URL` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_ID` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_SLUG` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY_BASE64` |  |
| `GITHUB_APP_WEBHOOK_SECRET` |  |
| `API_BASE_URL` |  |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | LLM gateway (gateway/models.toml routes each stage to a model). Set the key for each provider your models.toml actually uses; the others can stay empty. These are read by the gateway's settings object and handed to LiteLLM per call. They are never exported into os.environ, so git, docker and the sandbox cannot inherit them -- do not add them to sanitized_git_env or sanitized_docker_env. |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` |  |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` |  |
| `MINIMAX_API_KEY` |  |
| `GOOGLE_API_KEY` | A Vertex AI API key (not an AI Studio key), for the vertex-gemini-* models. Leave empty if unused: any non-empty value counts as configured. GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT is informational; the REST calls the gateway makes are bound to the key and do not send it. |
| `GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT` |  |
